player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I ignored the inventory limit (2 items) and tried to take the pillow while holding the plate and book, causing me to drop the book without realizing it. I also repeatedly tried to put the pillow on the counter in the living room without checking if a counter existed there, and I attempted to put the book on a shelf in the kitchen where no shelf was present. My next strategy will be: 1) Before taking any new item, check my current inventory count; if full, drop an item first using the correct syntax (e.g., "drop plate"). 2) Only attempt to place an item on a surface after confirming that surface exists in the current room description. 3) Systematically verify the location of each target surface (counter, shelf, table) before moving to that room to place the corresponding item.
